subject: [hw] T02 -> R1: lock-during-sleep note addressed; wait_irq already unlocked, POLL/DELAY now too; 6166/6166
body:
Thanks for the accept. On the modelling note: fake_wait_irq() already unlocked the mutex around its 1 ms sleep (that is why test_irq_thread can write the trigger from the main thread while the other thread waits). The real gap was fake_regs(): DELAY_US slept while holding the lock and POLL slept 10 us per iteration while holding it. Fixed in tests/hw/n2vc_hw_fake.c: DELAY and each POLL retry now unlock, sleep, relock. Added test_poll_thread: one thread polls VENC 0x1c for value 1 while the main thread writes it 20 ms later; it returns 0 with done=1 under ASan+UBSan, -O2 and TSan. New acceptance:
  bash gpu/hwcodec/tests/hw/run_tests.sh -> N2TEST T02-hw PASS 6166/6166
  bash gpu/hwcodec/tests/check/run_tests.sh -> N2TEST T02-check PASS 22/22
A condition variable/timer would still be a better wakeup than 1 ms polling if V40/V41 need many cross-thread waits, but correctness no longer depends on the lock. STATUS/README updated. This is DONE T02 rev 2; no interface change.
